note: Florence County, WI publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its GIS is a MapGuide/Colligo web viewer and an ArcGIS Experience parcel viewer, with no REST zoning layer found in ArcGIS search or on county pages. The only zoning files are UW-Madison Robinson Map Library archives (2021 and 2016) as zipped ESRI File Geodatabases at web.s3.wisc.edu/rml-gisdata/, not a service and not in a format the adapter reads (the 2021 zip has no shapefile; validation failed with 'the zip has no .shp'). No city zoning layer found; the city of Florence WI publishes none that I could locate.
